focus: KQ-R3c: step sequences repeated across the /speckit:* command assets (steps only, 8 files)
noveltyJustification: Prior rounds audited the command assets' checklist content (census §4, fixed in 011) but never compared the step graphs to each other: complete as the union of plan+implement, save_context as the only step in all three workflows (6 duplicated copies, two placeholder conventions), 14 validate.sh --strict invocations across 3 workflows (7 in complete alone), and the auto/confirm twins were all unrecorded.
keyQuestions: KQ-R3c: which step sequences are duplicated across commands, and is any command's body a subset of another's?
answeredQuestions: KQ-R3c: plan 1-4 == complete 1-4; implement 2-3-5-6-7 == complete 7-8-9-10-12; save_context in all three; no command is a strict subset of another (complete adds acceptance_criteria + acceptance_verify + 2 autopilot steps)

ruledOut.approach: Re-reporting the 011 checklist remediation per asset
ruledOut.reason: census §4 fixed and verified; the step-list inspection confirms no checklist residue, structural duplication remains

ruledOut.approach: Calling complete a strict subset of plan+implement
ruledOut.reason: complete adds acceptance_criteria/acceptance_verify/autopilot steps — union, not subset

statement: Complete's 16 steps: 12 names exist in plan (1-4 plus planning) or implement (task_breakdown..completion) with identical order — only acceptance_criteria, acceptance_verify and the autopilot steps are unique.
cost: every contract change (like 011's) edited 8 assets separately; three copies of two lifecycles to keep coherent
protects: nothing unique to the duplicated steps

statement: save_context (the generate-context.js node) is a step in all three lifecycle commands, duplicated in 6 files under two handover names, with two placeholder conventions for the same argument ({spec_path} in plan vs [spec-folder-path] in implement/complete).
cost: 6 copies of the continuity-writer invocation contract; placeholder drift already occurred between copies

statement: The identical full 39-rule gate is invoked 14 times across the three workflows (7 within complete alone), each re-validating the same folder after a different write; no note explains the cadence.
cost: post-011 each run also evaluates acceptance closure (AC_CLOSURE + AC_COVERAGE + strict trio) making the 7-in-one-workflow cadence heavier per run than at census time
protects: progressive validation (if each site guards a distinct write — unverified)

statement: Plan, implement and complete each maintain two near-identical 700-1300-line assets differing only in present_options_to_user insertion points (resume's confirm variant genuinely differs).
cost: 3 duplicated workflows; every edit applied twice; the confirm files are derivable from the auto file plus a checkpoint list
